name: RaHa Studio - LinkedIn AEC Content Pipeline (Free Tier)

nodes.name: Every 2 Days Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs 19:00 Asia/Dhaka (~9AM ET during EDT). Shift to 20:00 Nov-Mar (EST) manually.

parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/125.0 Safari/537.36

nodes.name: Fetch RSS Feeds (HTTP)
nodes.notes: Reddit's .rss/.atom endpoint 429s the built-in RSS Feed Read node because it can't send a custom User-Agent. This HTTP Request node spoofs a browser UA, retries 3x with a 3s gap, and continues on failure so one blocked feed doesn't kill the whole run.

nodes.name: Parse & Normalize Feed XML
nodes.notes: Reddit returns Atom XML (<entry>), Google News/ArchDaily return RSS 2.0 (<item>) — this parser handles both with regex, no external deps.

assignments.name: prompt
assignments.value:
=You are the content writer for RaHa Studio, a freelance architectural drafting/MEP/BIM practice (Revit specialist, ~10 years experience) targeting US clients, especially California ADU permit drawing sets. Write ONE LinkedIn post about this trending AEC topic: "{{$json.keyword}}" — context article: "{{$json.article.title}}" ({{$json.article.summary}}).

The post must be: a strong hook first line, short punchy paragraphs with line breaks, either educational / hot-take / "did you know" style, end with a clear CTA (e.g. inviting DMs/connections for ADU or construction doc work), and include naturally-woven SEO keywords (Revit, BIM, ADU, architecture, construction documents). Add 3-5 relevant hashtags.

Also write a separate detailed image-generation prompt for a clean, modern, professional architectural visual that complements the post (no text/words in the image, no people's faces, photorealistic or clean 3D render style).

Respond with ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences, no preamble, in exactly this shape:
{"post_text": "...", "hashtags": ["#tag1","#tag2"], "image_prompt": "..."}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ models: ["openrouter/free", "openai/gpt-oss-120b:free", "google/gemma-4-31b-it:free"], messages: [ { role: "user", content: $json.prompt } ], temperature: 0.9 }) }}

nodes.name: Generate Post + Image Prompt (OpenRouter)
nodes.notes: Uses OpenRouter's 'models' array so if the first free model is throttled or removed, it falls back automatically. Primary is 'openrouter/free' (OpenRouter's own auto-router across whatever free models are healthy right now), then two specific stable free slugs as of July 2026. Free-tier rate limit is currently ~20 req/min, ~200 req/day shared across all free models on your account. The free roster changes often (some models lose :free status without notice) — verify at openrouter.ai/models if you see repeated 429s.

nodes.name: Generate Image (Pollinations)
nodes.notes: No API key required for this volume. Register free key at enter.pollinations.ai only if you scale up frequency.

nodes.name: Upload to Drive
nodes.notes: The 'fields' option is set explicitly because Google Drive's API only returns fields you request — without this, webViewLink/webContentLink can come back missing (null) downstream.

nodes.name: Check Auto-Post Capability
nodes.notes: Hard-coded false: LinkedIn's w_member_social scope requires LinkedIn app-review approval for personal-profile posting, which is not reliably obtainable for free/small apps. Flip this only if you have that approval and add a LinkedIn node on the true branch.
